subproblem.title: Approximate tangent planes with multiplicity persist when μ is restricted to an open neighbourhood (parent Step 5)
subproblem.statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N, let W ⊆ ℝ^N be open, x ∈ W, P ⊆ ℝ^N a linear subspace and θ ∈ ℝ. Suppose HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ holds: dim P = n, and (rⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y) → θ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ⌞W) x P θ also holds, where μ⌞W is the restriction B ↦ μ(B ∩ W).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ.restrict W) x P θ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Step 5, first part. There, for x ∈ S ∩ W_i and f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ) with support in B_R(0), f∘η_{x,r} vanishes outside B_{rR}(x) ⊆ W_i for small r, so the blow-up integrals of μ⌞W_i and of μ agree. Here the argument is stated for an arbitrary open set W and an arbitrary multiplicity θ.

Notation. η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (blowUpMap x r); Hⁿ := μHE[n]; μ⌞W is the restriction B ↦ μ(B ∩ W).

1. The first clause of HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity, dim P = n, does not involve the measure. So it holds for μ⌞W by hypothesis.

2. Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ). Its topological support is compact, hence bounded, so tsupport f ⊆ B̄_{R₀}(0) for some R₀ ∈ ℝ. Put R := max(R₀, 0) + 1 > 0. If |z| ≥ R then z ∉ B̄_{R₀}(0) ⊇ tsupport f, so f(z) = 0.

3. Since W is open and x ∈ W, there is δ > 0 with B_δ(x) ⊆ W.

4. Let 0 < r < δ/R and let y ∉ W. Then y ∉ B_δ(x), so |y − x| ≥ δ, and |η_{x,r}(y)| = |y − x|/r ≥ δ/r > R. By step 2, f(η_{x,r}(y)) = 0.

5. Hence for 0 < r < δ/R the function g_r(y) := f(η_{x,r}(y)) vanishes outside W, that is, g_r = 1_W·g_r. Therefore ∫ g_r d(μ⌞W) = ∫_W g_r dμ = ∫ 1_W g_r dμ = ∫ g_r dμ. The integrands 1_W g_r and g_r are equal, so this equality of Bochner integrals needs no integrability assumption (Mathlib setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero).

6. Consider the two functions r ↦ (rⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) d(μ⌞W)(y) and r ↦ (rⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y). By step 5 they coincide on the interval (0, δ/R), which is a neighbourhood of 0 within (0, ∞). By hypothesis the second tends to θ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0, so the first does too.

7. Since f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ) was arbitrary, steps 1 and 6 give HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ⌞W) x P θ. ∎
proof_key_steps: The dimension clause dim P = n is unchanged
tsupport f ⊆ B̄_{R₀}(0), so f(z) = 0 for |z| ≥ R := max(R₀,0)+1
B_δ(x) ⊆ W; for 0 < r < δ/R, f∘η_{x,r} vanishes off W
For such r the blow-up integrals against μ⌞W and against μ coincide
Eventual equality on (0, δ/R) transfers the limit θ∫_P f dHⁿ

audit.reason: All hypotheses match. Compact support makes each rescaled test function vanish outside W eventually, giving equality of the totalized integrals without extra integrability assumptions. This transfers the exact tangent predicate for arbitrary θ.
